description: Unified login API endpoint handling both employee and admin authentication. Accepts POST requests with username, password, and role parameters. Returns JSON response with success status and redirect URL.
notes: Accepts role as hidden parameter allowing potential privilege escalation. Has basic SQL injection filter checking for quotes and semicolons. Default credentials: emp/emppassword (employee), admin/Q&(GHD)*!X#BY (admin). May be vulnerable to authentication bypass if filter is inadequate.
